what_happened.line: The Agricultural Commission tabled its reorganization and reappointments to the next meeting, since Select Board reappointments are scheduled for June 1.
Members reviewed a draft promotional flyer listing Lunenburg farms and the farmers market; it will be reorganized into retail, roadside stand, CSA and market sections.
The commission leaned toward ordering fewer flyers and reordering if they prove popular, after hearing a printing estimate.
The pop-up market question was left for next meeting, with a member to contact Highland Farm; the next meeting was set for June 17.

why_it_matters: The commission is preparing printed material to promote local farms and the farmers market, a small outlay that supports local agriculture, and it took no votes affecting the town budget or regulations.
watch_next: Select Board reappointments on June 1, then the commission's reorganization at its June 17 meeting.
An updated flyer draft and a decision on the pop-up market, both due at the June 17 meeting.
